read.thesis: Record $78B backlog (+96% y/y) and Power Gen retail +75%, but capacity is the pacing factor; capex trimmed to $3.3B from $3.5B while large-engine output is set to nearly triple by 2030.

utilisation.quote: bringing additional capacity online is still the top pacing factor for growth in Power and Energy

capex.quote: Our CapEx spend for 2026 is now anticipated to be about $3.3 billion, which is slightly below our prior expectations of $3.5 billion.

triggers.label: 2026 capex $3.5B → $3.3B
triggers.quote: Our CapEx spend for 2026 is now anticipated to be about $3.3 billion, which is slightly below our prior expectations of $3.5 billion.

triggers.label: Power gen retail sales +75%
triggers.quote: Power generation grew 75%, driven by continued very strong demand for turbines and large reciprocating engines used in data center applications.

triggers.label: Large-engine capacity ~3x 2024 by 2030
triggers.quote: The initiative directly supports previously announced plans to increase large reciprocating engine capacity to nearly 3x to the '24 level by 2030.

triggers.label: Q4 dealer destock ~$1.6B
triggers.quote: we anticipate the typical seasonal dealer inventory reduction to be roughly $1.6 billion

triggers.label: Margin near bottom of target range
triggers.quote: Excluding IEEPA tariff recoveries, our full year adjusted operating profit margin is expected to be near the bottom of our target range.

guidance.quote: we continue to expect full year 2026 sales and revenues to grow in the mid- to high teens
Excluding IEEPA tariff recoveries, our full year adjusted operating profit margin is expected to be near the bottom of our target range.
Our CapEx spend for 2026 is now anticipated to be about $3.3 billion, which is slightly below our prior expectations of $3.5 billion.
We now expect restructuring costs of about $300 million in 2026, which is on the low end of our prior range.
We also continue to expect MP&E free cash flow to be in the top half of our annual target range of $6 billion to $15 billion.

red_flags.quote: lower in mining due to delays in shipping and commissioning

red_flags.label: Cost inflation headwind
red_flags.quote: we are aware of potential headwinds presented by higher cost inflation, which we continue to monitor closely
